source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Note the Building ID.
3. Note whether the building is also owned. If it is not owned, then the instructions end here. Return to the main workflow.
4. If you know the owner, then check your `OWNER_LOG` file to see if a row exists for that owner. This check should be done before returning to the main workflow. 
5. Find the building in the first sheet (`Buildings`) of a the County spreadsheet. 
6. Check the row for a "X" in any of the 7 columns that begin with the word "Barrier". 
7. Open the corresponding sheet named "Barrier Free" or "Barrier Free Check"

8. If there is a "X" under the column for that particular barrier, click on the cell and note the number in the C column of the same row.

9. If the number in the C column is a 0, note
